hooks.command: H="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks"; [ -f "$H/sync-cloud-skills.sh" ] || { P="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"; T="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; T="$(cd "${T:-/nonexistent}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"; case "$T/" in "${P%/}"/*) H="$T/.claude/hooks";; esac; }; [ -f "$H/sync-cloud-skills.sh" ] || exit 0; bash "$H/sync-cloud-skills.sh"
